stage: Extension fixed after the informative balanced-null check, before any nonzero-signal proxy simulation
purpose: Check the same finite-root boundary when utility signal is nonzero and the proxy is genuinely informative conditional on the utility covariates
DGP: X~N_p(0,I),Y|X~Bernoulli(sigmoid(gamma X1)),Z is Y independently flipped with probability epsilon. Frozen g(X1,Z)=sigmoid(gamma X1+(2Z-1)log((1-epsilon)/epsilon)).
population_moments: Compute oracle Brier risk by one-dimensional adaptive integration; E[Wg]=E[WY] by the conditional-mean identity. Check posterior formula against Bayes probabilities at fixed covariates.
reported_evidence: Direct original X,Y,Z draws and finite-root frequencies; candidate limiting ratio(c^2-a(gamma)^2)/R. No exact finite-label formula is claimed for the signal case.
limits: Gaussian binary benchmark, population auxiliary loss, externally frozen oracle, no finite-dimensional coverage or priority certificate.
